(2) Setting the substituted text in the first `<hp:t>` and deleting subsequent runs is the correct way to handle these splits. (3) Deleting the `<hp:lineSegArray>` element is essential to prevent rendering artifacts caused by stale layout cache. (4) Dynamic namespace extraction from the root element ensures compatibility across different HWPX versions.
